title: On the Interplay between Fairness and Explainability

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating empirical fairness by measuring downstream performance disparity (macro-F1 score difference) between male and female biographies on the BIOS occupation classification dataset. The study also evaluates bias by training a probing classifier to predict gender from model representations and extracting post-hoc explanations (LRP) to identify reliance on gendered words.

Evaluating empirical fairness by measuring downstream performance disparity (macro-F1 score difference) between Eastern European defendant states versus the rest of the states on the ECtHR legal judgment forecasting dataset. The study also uses a probing classifier to predict the nationality attribute from model representations.
